key_highlights: RBA delivers another interest rate hike to an 18-year high, intensifying mortgage strain and economic slowdown risks
Major Australian banks issue recession warnings as the Australian dollar drops sharply amid mounting growth concerns
National housing downturn accelerates with price drops nearing 40-year records alongside rising rental vacancies
Energy equities face headwinds from plunging global oil prices and domestic diesel supply constraints
Tech and retail face margin pressure highlighted by Canva workforce cuts and David Jones store closures

sectors.trend: Net interest margin expansion offset by rising bad debt provisions and mortgage stress
sectors.implications: Major banks face decelerating credit growth and heightened default risks as debt-servicing burdens reach decades-long highs

sectors.trend: Severe valuation contractions driven by multi-month property price declines and elevated borrowing costs
sectors.implications: Asset devaluations and investor retreat post negative gearing adjustments weigh on residential and commercial property trusts

sectors.trend: Downside price shock in crude oil coupled with domestic diesel shortage threats
sectors.implications: Earnings compression for upstream producers like Woodside and Santos, alongside operating cost pressures for freight-exposed sectors

sectors.trend: Severe spending curtailment as household budgets buckle under rising debt service ratios
sectors.implications: Department stores and discretionary retailers face margin degradation and store footprint rationalisations

sectors.trend: Cost rationalisation across tech scale-ups balanced against global tech sector tailwinds
sectors.implications: Local tech valuations face scrutiny following major workforce reductions at Canva, although ASX tech tracks Wall Street momentum

sectors.trend: Selective exploration activity in gold and battery minerals against broader macroeconomic volatility
sectors.implications: Junior explorers maintain targeted drilling while macro headwinds and currency fluctuations dictate major bulk miner performance

key_themes: Aggressive RBA monetary tightening triggering systemic mortgage and household cash flow strain
Elevated domestic recession probabilities driving currency depreciation and banking sector caution
Persistent housing market downturn exacerbated by policy and rate headwinds
Commodity price volatility with crude oil slump contrasting with critical mineral development

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Severe Economic Slowdown and Bank Credit Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-beta cyclical equities and major bank exposures; increase allocation to cash and high-grade short-duration debt

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Liquidity Crunch and Valuation Reset
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid leveraged residential REITs and housing construction suppliers; focus on non-discretionary retail assets

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Energy Price Collapse and Fuel Supply Disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel costs for transport fleets and trim overweight exposure to unhedged oil and gas producers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Regulatory and Employment Tax Liabilities for Gig / Tech Platforms
risk_assessment.mitigation: Audit supply chain and platform contractor structures for payroll tax liabilities following High Court precedent

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on Gold Exploration and Defensive Hedging
opportunities.rationale: Gold remains a resilient store of value amidst currency depreciation and stagflationary pressures

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to Export-Oriented Healthcare and Critical Materials
opportunities.rationale: A weakened AUD provides foreign-earnings translation tailwinds for global healthcare leaders and niche resource producers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Highly Leveraged Commercial and Residential Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising arrears and slowing credit growth threaten net interest margins and capital return stability

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Discretionary Retail and Oil Producer Holdings
defensive_moves.rationale: Crude oil collapse and deteriorating disposable household incomes will curtail retail margins and energy cash flows
ASX 200 vulnerability to terminal rate expectations and global macro slowdown warrants tactical portfolio hedging

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias over 1–3 months as the market digests the RBA rate hike to 18-year highs, rising loan distress, and softening corporate earnings guidance.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious stabilization over 6–12 months conditional on terminal rate clarity, inflation moderation, and currency-driven support for offshore revenue earners.
key_catalysts: RBA post-meeting minutes and revised quarterly Statement on Monetary Policy forecasts
Quarterly GDP and domestic unemployment data releases signalling recession severity
Banking sector half-year credit provisioning updates and non-performing loan trends
OPEC+ production responses to crude oil price downturn
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate trajectory near key psychological support levels
National auction clearance rates and monthly CoreLogic dwelling value index updates
WTI / Brent crude oil benchmark pricing and Australian wholesale diesel inventory levels
ASX 200 200-day moving average and financial sector credit default swaps
